name: Fuyo General Lease Co., Ltd.
summary: Fuyo General Lease Co., Ltd. engages in the leasing and instalment sales business in Japan, the United States, Ireland, and internationally. The company operates through Lease and Installment Sales; Financing; and Others segments. The company provides leasing services for information-related and office equipment, and industrial machine tools; and engages in sales of properties related to the sale of goods; as well as real estate leasing and installment sales of commercial, production, and hospital facilities, etc. It also invests in marketable securities and offers loans.
